note: What the health sweep alerts on. The sweep runs the diagnostics as SYSTEM through the agent, so per-user state (OneDrive folder backup, File History) is not alerted on here; the console's diagnose runs report it. Each rule turns the sweep's monitor down with its message (no names: the PC's alias only). Days are counted from the newest successful value the PC reported.

rules.message: a drive reports it is failing
the Windows drive is nearly full

no new restore point for a month
